scope: Read-only CLI projection of the registered V4 standard plugin library.
boundary_rule: The CLI may only read standard plugin descriptors and permission projections; it never starts a server, binds a port, reads or writes ~/.rcc, manages processes, or mutates runtime state.
error_rule: Unknown plugin and node identifiers fail with a non-zero exit code; no fallback or partial projection is allowed.
determinism_rule: List and projection outputs are deterministic and derived from routecodex-v4-standard-plugins without provider credentials or business payloads.
